scenarios.message: I've basically worn out my copy of Nirvana's Nevermind. Got any other 90s alt or grunge on vinyl? $35 max.
Daft Punk's Discovery is on repeat in my flat. What else have you got that grooves like that?
Everything Everywhere All at Once was the best thing I've seen in years. More weird, inventive films please, under $25.
I've read Kafka on the Shore twice now. What else would a Murakami person like in here?
My 8 year old has watched Frozen and Coco about a hundred times. Something new for her, under $30?
Hereditary messed me up in the best possible way. What other horror films do you have?
My 15 year old lives in Skyrim. What other games would he sink into? $40 max.
I'm a Bob Dylan and Neil Young guy. Looking for more singer-songwriter records, under $30.
My girlfriend tore through City of Bones in two days. What should I get her next?
Big Nolan fan here, The Dark Knight and Inception are my two favourites. Any films or soundtracks you'd point me to?
My husband says The Wire is the best TV ever made. What box set would he get into? Under $80.
I mostly listen to Sufjan Stevens and Big Thief. Any records in here for me?
My 6 year old loves the Paddington films. Anything here she'd enjoy?
I love Rocky and the Creed movies, basically any good sports story. Got any books under $25?
My mum is 70 and adores Downton Abbey. What could I get her?
I mainly play Halo and Call of Duty. Any shooters here under $40?
My 13 year old is obsessed with Sabrina Carpenter and Gracie Abrams. Vinyl for her, $40 max?
Anything for a Nick Cave fan?
My partner just finished Schitt's Creek and needs another feel-good comedy box set.
I'm a big Sofia Coppola fan, The Virgin Suicides especially. What would you pull for me, under $30?
My grandad is 75, loves Steely Dan, Columbo and old Clint Eastwood films. Something under $35?
I'm hooked on true crime podcasts like Serial, loved Killers of the Flower Moon and The Social Network. Any books for me?
I'm into Fallout, Blade Runner 2049 and Daft Punk. What would you hand me? $40 max.
Pulp's Different Class, Trainspotting and Irvine Welsh books are my whole personality. Any music for me?
My sister knows every word of Hamilton and loves Encanto. What would make her happy?
I love the game Hades, Madeline Miller's Circe and Florence + the Machine. What else?
I'm into Parks and Rec, The Office and Wet Leg. What would you recommend?
My boyfriend loves Kendrick, Childish Gambino's Atlanta and Get Out. What would he like?
Tim Burton films, The Cure and Edgar Allan Poe, that's me. What have you got?
I loved The Expanse, The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy and Outer Wilds. What else would I like?
